title: a TS -> Python -> Rust child chain completes with the correct nested result under kill -9 and child failpoints

modes.rotation: iteration % 6: random, start_child_after_flush, random, parent_event_before_flush, random, all three child:: failpoints armed
modes.random: 1..=3 kill -9, each after a delay from the start ack or the previous restart: uniform 0..1500 ms, half of the draws 0..80 ms (the chain's in-flight window)
modes.failpoint: restart armed before the root starts; start_child_after_flush=pause, kill -9 once the root journal shows child_started (the sink is blocked at the site); otherwise <site>=1*print(crash-leg hit <site>), kill -9 as soon as the line is logged; restart unarmed. child::detached_after_flush is unreachable from an attached chain and is only armed in the all-three mode

checks: root completed with the nested echo within 60 s of the last restart
root and Python run journal exactly one child_started and one child_completed
child ids are the deterministic child_run_id(parent, op) (D-P9-7)
the server lists exactly one py_conf_parent_chain and one rs_conf_leaf_echo run per root
every run journals exactly one run_started and one terminal event; no run is left non-terminal
